svg.text: 9 tables · derived from the final ER diagram
user_id is PK and FK → users (subtype, no own ID)
PK (user_id, post_id) — one like per user/post
PK (user_id, comment_id) — one like per user/comment
CHECK: exactly one of post_id, comment_id,
Composite PK that is also FK
NN = NOT NULL · NULL = nullable FK
Parent end: 1 or 0..1 (optional) · child end: N
Dashed arc: exactly one report target (XOR)
• Every table has a PK; each M:N is resolved by a junction table with a composite PK (post_likes, comment_likes, follows).
• Moderator-only data lives in moderators (PK = FK to users); no user attributes are duplicated.
• reports stores references to its target (post / comment / reply), never copied content.
• Moderator review is 1:N with no attributes, so it is the nullable reviewed_by FK rather than a separate table.
